purpose: Canonical hard region requirements, boundary overrides, and aliases used by planners. These override looser geographic tagging elsewhere in the dataset.

boundary_overrides.planner_rule: Treat Burthorpe, Death Plateau, Trollheim, Troll Stronghold and the God Wars Dungeon approach as part of Asgarnia. Do not expose them as a separate selectable region.
boundary_overrides.evidence_note: The user supplied the working Equilibrium region map and explicitly confirmed this boundary for planner use.

dependencies.planner_rule: Treat Dungeoneering/Daemonheim as unavailable unless the player selects the Forinthry/Wilderness region.
Any content reached through Burthorpe, Death Plateau, Trollheim or Troll Stronghold resolves to Asgarnia unless a later official Equilibrium boundary explicitly overrides it.
